shortDescription: The 2-year Treasury yield this morning surpassed its 2026 high and recently traded at 4.375%, its highest level since Feb. 12, 2025.This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).
